<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>(a+b)³ — Step 1</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#2f8a3e;
    --ink-soft:#2f8a3e;
    --paper:#ffffff;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{height:100%;margin:0}
  body{
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;
    overflow:hidden;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  #wrap{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:10px 8px 12px;gap:4px}

  /* ---- step controls ---- */
  #nav{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:26px;flex:0 0 auto;padding-top:4px}
  .navbtn{
    width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;
    border:2.5px solid var(--ink);background:transparent;
    display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);
    transition:background-color .15s ease, transform .1s ease, opacity .15s ease;
    padding:0;
  }
  .navbtn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(47,138,62,.09)}
  .navbtn:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.94)}
  .navbtn:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:default}
  .navbtn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(47,138,62,.45);outline-offset:3px}
  .navbtn svg{width:26px;height:26px;display:block}

  /* ---- stage ---- */
  /* drawing and equation travel together, centred in what's left below the nav */
  #body{
    flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    justify-content:center;gap:6px;
  }
  #stage{
    flex:1 1 auto;position:relative;min-height:0;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;
    transition:max-height .45s ease;
  }
  #stage.dragging{cursor:grabbing}
  #cv{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
  #hint{
    position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:2px;transform:translateX(-50%);
    font-size:19px;opacity:.55;pointer-events:none;letter-spacing:.3px;
    transition:opacity .4s ease;
  }
  #hint.gone{opacity:0}

  /* ---- equation ---- */
  #eq{
    flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    padding:6px 16px 2px;overflow:hidden;
  }
  /* the equation stays on one line and scales to whatever width there is */
  #eqinner{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;white-space:nowrap;
    font-size:50px;line-height:1;transform-origin:center center;
  }
  #eq .lead{white-space:nowrap;font-size:0.84em}
  #eq .plus{font-size:0.82em;display:inline-block}

  /* --- the finish: boxes and scaffolding fall away, terms combine --- */
  #lead-volume{
    display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;
    transition:opacity 1.1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),
               max-width 1.1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),
               margin-right 1.1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1);
  }
  #eqinner.done #lead-volume{ opacity:0;margin-right:-5px }
  #eqinner.done .slot{
    border-color:transparent !important;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;
  }
  .eq-gone{
    opacity:0 !important;width:0 !important;
    margin-left:-5px !important;padding:0 !important;overflow:hidden;
    border-width:0 !important;
  }
  /* the 3 arrives beside the middle term without disturbing the layout */
  .slot{ position:relative }
  .coef{
    position:absolute;right:calc(100% - 7px);top:50%;
    transform:translateY(-50%) scale(.7);
    opacity:0;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity 1.1s ease, transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1);
  }
  .coef.in{ opacity:1;transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1) }
  .plus, .slot{
    transition:width 1.1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), opacity .95s ease .3s,
               margin-left 1.1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),
               transform 1.2s ease-in-out,
               border-color .8s ease, background-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  }
  @keyframes termpop{ 0%{transform:scale(1)} 40%{transform:scale(1.18)} 100%{transform:scale(1)} }
  .slot.pop{ animation:termpop .9s ease }
  #stage{ transition:max-height .9s ease, opacity 1.2s ease }
  #stage.closing{ transition:max-height 1.9s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), opacity 1.5s ease }
  #eqinner.closing .plus, #eqinner.closing .slot{
    transition:width 1.9s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),
               margin-left 1.9s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),
               border-width 1.9s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),
               opacity .9s ease;
  }
  sup{font-size:.62em;vertical-align:super}
  .tm{white-space:nowrap}
  .slot{
    width:2.00em;height:1.58em;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:6px;
    display:inline-grid;place-items:center;font-size:0.76em;line-height:1;
    user-select:none;
  }
  .slot.active{
    background:rgba(47,138,62,.10);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(47,138,62,.28);
  }
  .slot.active{ cursor:pointer }
  .slot.drop{ background:rgba(47,138,62,.26) }
  .slot:focus{ outline:none }
  .slot.filled{ font-size:0.68em }
  /* the four volumes to choose from, floating just above the box in question */
  #keys{
    position:fixed;left:0;top:0;z-index:60;display:none;align-items:center;
    gap:8px;padding:9px 11px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%,#f3faf4 52%,#e7f4e9 100%);
    border:2px solid rgba(47,138,62,.38);border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(47,138,62,.20),
               0 2px 0 rgba(47,138,62,.18),
               inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95);
    transition:transform .2s ease, opacity .25s ease;
  }
  #keys.on{display:flex}
  #keycaret{
    position:absolute;bottom:-9px;width:14px;height:14px;background:#e7f4e9;
    border-right:2px solid rgba(47,138,62,.38);border-bottom:2px solid rgba(47,138,62,.38);
    transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
  }
  #keys.below #keycaret{
    bottom:auto;top:-9px;
    border:0;border-left:2px solid rgba(47,138,62,.38);border-top:2px solid rgba(47,138,62,.38);
  }
  .key{
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    font-family:inherit;color:var(--ink);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%,#f5fbf6 58%,#e6f4e9 100%);
    border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:10px;
    font-size:min(28px, 3.2vw);line-height:1;padding:7px 17px;cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(47,138,62,.30), 0 5px 12px rgba(47,138,62,.16),
               inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.98);
    transition:background-color .12s ease, transform .09s ease,
               box-shadow .09s ease, opacity .15s ease;
  }
  /* the sheen across the upper half */
  .key::before{
    content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:52%;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.92),rgba(255,255,255,0));
    border-radius:8px 8px 40% 40%/8px 8px 14px 14px;pointer-events:none;
  }
  .key sup{font-size:.62em;vertical-align:super}
  .key:hover:not(:disabled){background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%,#eef9f0 58%,#dcefe0 100%)}
  .key:active:not(:disabled){
    transform:translateY(3px);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(47,138,62,.30), 0 2px 5px rgba(47,138,62,.14),
               inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  }
  .key:disabled{opacity:.33;cursor:default}
  .key:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(47,138,62,.45);outline-offset:3px}

  /* a wrong choice is shown for a moment, then taken back out */
  @keyframes slotwrong{
    0%   { background:rgba(192,57,43,.18); border-color:#c0392b }
    60%  { background:rgba(192,57,43,.18); border-color:#c0392b }
    100% { background:transparent; border-color:var(--ink) }
  }
  .slot.wrong{ animation:slotwrong .52s ease; color:#c0392b }

  #ghost, #hintghost{
    position:fixed;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;display:none;
  }
  #ghost{ z-index:50; opacity:.92; transition:transform .07s ease-out }
  #hintghost{ z-index:49; opacity:0 }
  .plus{padding:0}

  @media (max-width:620px){
    .navbtn{width:46px;height:46px}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    .navbtn{transition:none}
  }

  /* --- Bhanzu Spark watermark --- */
  #watermark{
    position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;
    background-repeat:no-repeat;
    background-position:center 50%;
    background-size:34% auto;
    opacity:0.085;
    background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,");
  }
  #wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="watermark"></div>
<div id="wrap">

  <div id="nav">
    <button class="navbtn" id="prev" aria-label="Previous step" disabled>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16.5 4.5 L5.5 12 L16.5 19.5 Z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
    </button>
    <button class="navbtn" id="next" aria-label="Next step">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.5 4.5 L18.5 12 L7.5 19.5 Z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
    </button>
    <button class="navbtn" id="reset" aria-label="Reset the cube's position">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <path d="M20 8.5 A8 8 0 1 0 21 14.5"/>
        <path d="M14.6 8.9 L20.4 8.2 L19.7 2.9"/>
      </svg>
    </button>
  </div>

  <div id="body">
  <div id="stage">
    <canvas id="cv"></canvas>
    <div id="hint">drag the cube to turn it</div>
  </div>

  <div id="eq"><div id="eqinner">
    <span class="lead" id="lead-volume">Volume =</span>
    <span class="lead" id="lead-expr">(A+B)<sup>3</sup> =</span>
    <span class="slot" data-slot="0"></span><span class="plus">+</span>
    <span class="slot" data-slot="1"></span><span class="plus">+</span>
    <span class="slot" data-slot="2"></span><span class="plus">+</span>
    <span class="slot" data-slot="3"></span><span class="plus">+</span>
    <span class="slot" data-slot="4"></span><span class="plus">+</span>
    <span class="slot" data-slot="5"></span><span class="plus">+</span>
    <span class="slot" data-slot="6"></span><span class="plus">+</span>
    <span class="slot" data-slot="7"></span>
  </div></div>

  </div>

</div>

<div id="keys">
  <button class="key" type="button" data-v="A³">A<sup>3</sup></button>
  <button class="key" type="button" data-v="A²B">A<sup>2</sup>B</button>
  <button class="key" type="button" data-v="AB²">AB<sup>2</sup></button>
  <button class="key" type="button" data-v="B³">B<sup>3</sup></button>
  <span id="keycaret"></span>
</div>

<canvas id="ghost"></canvas>
<canvas id="hintghost"></canvas>

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  /* ============================================================
     PALETTE  — the only colour decisions in the file
     ink    : structure (axes-equivalents, dimension marks, wording)
     cube   : the whole cube, and the (a+b)³ side of the identity
     blocks : the eight pieces, in row order a³ | a²b ×3 | ab² ×3 | b³
     keys   : the keyboard, one per volume
     ============================================================ */
  var PAL = {
    paper : '#FCFCFA',
    ink   : '#2E3340',
    cube  : '#5A57D6',
    blocks: ['#1FA36B','#0EA5C9','#4CC3E0','#0B7C9B','#D9486F','#E8748F','#B83457','#D98A1F'],
    keys  : ['#1FA36B','#0EA5C9','#D9486F','#D98A1F']
  };
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ink', PAL.ink);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--paper', PAL.paper);

  /* ============================================================
     Model identity + step framework
     ============================================================ */
  var MODEL = 'cube-a-plus-b-cubed';
  var STEPS = [
    { id: 'solid',    reveal: 0, apart: 0    },  // the whole cube, nothing showing through
    { id: 'sliced',   reveal: 1, apart: 0    },  // cut planes and hidden edges revealed
    { id: 'exploded', reveal: 1, apart: 0.40 },  // eight blocks pushed apart, held there
    { id: 'arranged', reveal: 1, apart: 1    }   // blocks laid out as a sum beside the cube
  ];
  var step  = 0;

  /* ============================================================
     Geometry constants
     ============================================================ */
  var A = 1.70, B = 1.00, S = A + B;    // cube side = a + b, cut at a
  var HALF = S / 2;

  var cv  = document.getElementById('cv');
  var ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  var stage = document.getElementById('stage');

  /* centred object-space point */
  function P(x, y, z){ return [x - HALF, y - HALF, z - HALF]; }

  /* ---- faces: axis 0=x 1=y 2=z, side 0 => coord 0, side 1 => coord S ---- */
  var faces = [];
  for (var ax = 0; ax < 3; ax++){
    for (var sd = 0; sd < 2; sd++){
      var n = [0,0,0]; n[ax] = sd ? 1 : -1;
      var c = [0,0,0]; c[ax] = sd ? HALF : -HALF;
      var u = (ax + 1) % 3, v = (ax + 2) % 3;
      var quad = [];
      var corners = [[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1]];
      for (var q = 0; q < 4; q++){
        var pt = [0,0,0];
        pt[ax] = sd ? S : 0;
        pt[u] = corners[q][0] ? S : 0;
        pt[v] = corners[q][1] ? S : 0;
        quad.push(P(pt[0], pt[1], pt[2]));
      }
      faces.push({ n:n, c:c, q:quad });
    }
  }
  function faceId(axis, side){ return axis * 2 + side; }

  /* ---- 12 outer edges, each tagged with its two adjacent faces ---- */
  var edgesOuter = [];
  for (var axE = 0; axE < 3; axE++){
    var o1 = (axE + 1) % 3, o2 = (axE + 2) % 3;
    for (var s1 = 0; s1 < 2; s1++){
      for (var s2 = 0; s2 < 2; s2++){
        var p0 = [0,0,0], p1 = [0,0,0];
        p0[o1] = p1[o1] = s1 ? S : 0;
        p0[o2] = p1[o2] = s2 ? S : 0;
        p0[axE] = 0; p1[axE] = S;
        edgesOuter.push({
          a: P(p0[0],p0[1],p0[2]),
          b: P(p1[0],p1[1],p1[2]),
          f: [faceId(o1,s1), faceId(o2,s2)]
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /* ---- 12 slice edges: three cutting planes x=a, y=a, z=a.
         Each plane meets the cube in a square whose 4 sides lie on outer faces. ---- */
  var edgesCut = [];
  for (var axC = 0; axC < 3; axC++){
    var c1 = (axC + 1) % 3, c2 = (axC + 2) % 3;
    for (var sC = 0; sC < 2; sC++){
      var q0, q1;
      /* runs along c2, pinned to face c1 */
      q0 = [0,0,0]; q1 = [0,0,0];
      q0[axC] = q1[axC] = A;
      q0[c1] = q1[c1] = sC ? S : 0;
      q0[c2] = 0; q1[c2] = S;
      edgesCut.push({ a:P(q0[0],q0[1],q0[2]), b:P(q1[0],q1[1],q1[2]), f:[faceId(c1,sC)] });
      /* runs along c1, pinned to face c2 */
      q0 = [0,0,0]; q1 = [0,0,0];
      q0[axC] = q1[axC] = A;
      q0[c2] = q1[c2] = sC ? S : 0;
      q0[c1] = 0; q1[c1] = S;
      edgesCut.push({ a:P(q0[0],q0[1],q0[2]), b:P(q1[0],q1[1],q1[2]), f:[faceId(c2,sC)] });
    }
  }

  /* ---- candidate measuring edges: for each axis, the 4 edges parallel to it.
         The one sitting furthest outside on screen gets the a / b labels. ---- */
  var dimCandidates = [[], [], []];
  for (var axD = 0; axD < 3; axD++){
    var d1 = (axD + 1) % 3, d2 = (axD + 2) % 3;
    for (var t1 = 0; t1 < 2; t1++){
      for (var t2 = 0; t2 < 2; t2++){
        var ga = [0,0,0], gm = [0,0,0], gb = [0,0,0];
        ga[d1] = gm[d1] = gb[d1] = t1 ? S : 0;
        ga[d2] = gm[d2] = gb[d2] = t2 ? S : 0;
        ga[axD] = 0; gm[axD] = A; gb[axD] = S;
        dimCandidates[axD].push({
          a: P(ga[0],ga[1],ga[2]),
          m: P(gm[0],gm[1],gm[2]),
          b: P(gb[0],gb[1],gb[2]),
          f: [faceId(d1,t1), faceId(d2,t2)]
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /* pick the visible edge that reads as furthest out, leaning bottom-right */
  function pickDim(axis){
    var best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
    var list = dimCandidates[axis];
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
      var e = list[i];
      if (!faceVisible(e.f[0]) && !faceVisible(e.f[1])) continue;
      var pa = project(e.a), pb = project(e.b);
      var mx = (pa[0] + pb[0]) / 2 - cx, my = (pa[1] + pb[1]) / 2 - cy;
      var score = Math.hypot(mx, my) + 0.30 * my + 0.16 * mx;
      if (score > bestScore){ bestScore = score; best = e; }
    }
    return best;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     Rotation state
     ============================================================ */
  function rotX(t){ var c=Math.cos(t), s=Math.sin(t); return [1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c]; }
  function rotY(t){ var c=Math.cos(t), s=Math.sin(t); return [c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c]; }
  function mul(M, N){
    var O = new Array(9);
    for (var r=0;r<3;r++) for (var c=0;c<3;c++){
      var sum=0; for (var k=0;k<3;k++) sum += M[r*3+k]*N[k*3+c];
      O[r*3+c]=sum;
    }
    return O;
  }
  function xf(M, v){
    return [ M[0]*v[0]+M[1]*v[1]+M[2]*v[2],
             M[3]*v[0]+M[4]*v[1]+M[5]*v[2],
             M[6]*v[0]+M[7]*v[1]+M[8]*v[2] ];
  }
  function HOME(){ return mul(rotX(-0.33), rotY(0.56)); }
  var R = HOME();

  var F = 1, cx = 0, cy = 0, W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

  /* Parallel (orthographic) projection, like the drawing this is based on:
     edges stay parallel, and a block is the same size wherever it sits. That
     is what lets a block in the sum match its counterpart inside the cube. */
  function project(v){
    var p = xf(R, v);
    return [cx + p[0]*F, cy - p[1]*F];
  }
  function faceVisible(i){
    return xf(R, faces[i].n)[2] < 0;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     Hand-drawn strokes
     ============================================================ */
  function hash(n){ var x = Math.sin(n * 127.1) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x); }

  function sketch(x0, y0, x1, y1, seed){
    var j = 1.5;
    var ax = x0 + (hash(seed)      - .5) * j, ay = y0 + (hash(seed+1.7) - .5) * j;
    var bx = x1 + (hash(seed+3.1)  - .5) * j, by = y1 + (hash(seed+4.3) - .5) * j;
    var dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    var bow = (hash(seed + 8.9) - .5) * Math.min(len * 0.022, 5);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ax, ay);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo((ax+bx)/2 - dy/len*bow, (ay+by)/2 + dx/len*bow, bx, by);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  /* (x,y) is the tip; (dx,dy) is the direction the arrow points.
     The barbs sweep back from the tip, not forward off it. */
  function arrowHead(x, y, dx, dy, seed, ss){
    var len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    var bx = -dx/len, by = -dy/len, L = 12 * (ss || 1), sp = 0.40;
    var cs = Math.cos(sp), sn = Math.sin(sp);
    sketch(x, y, x + (bx*cs - by*sn)*L, y + (bx*sn + by*cs)*L, seed);
    sketch(x, y, x + (bx*cs + by*sn)*L, y + (-bx*sn + by*cs)*L, seed + 2);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     Render
     ============================================================ */
  var eqBox = document.getElementById('eq'), eqInner = document.getElementById('eqinner');
  document.getElementById('lead-expr').style.color = PAL.cube;
  var maxScale = 1;

  function fitEquation(){
    eqInner.style.transform = 'none';
    eqBox.style.height = '';
    var pcs = getComputedStyle(eqBox);
    var natural = eqInner.scrollWidth;
    var avail = eqBox.clientWidth - parseFloat(pcs.paddingLeft) - parseFloat(pcs.paddingRight);
    if (!natural || avail <= 0) return;
    var k = (widthTarget > 0)
      ? Math.min(1.9, widthTarget / natural, avail / natural)
      : Math.min(maxScale, avail / natural);
    eqInner.style.transform = 'scale(' + k + ')';
    var pad = parseFloat(pcs.paddingTop) + parseFloat(pcs.paddingBottom);
    eqBox.style.height = Math.ceil(eqInner.offsetHeight * k + pad + 4) + 'px';
  }

  /* While the equation is rearranging, its width changes every frame. Refitting
     once at the start and once at the end makes it lurch; this keeps the fit
     continuous for the length of the move instead. */
  var fitRAF = 0, fitUntil = 0, growFrom = 0, growTo = 1, growT0 = 0, growMs = 0;
  /* During the last move the equation should hold its width while the terms
     close up and the type swells — otherwise it bulges outwards and pulls
     back in. So the target is a width, and the scale follows from it. */
  var widthTarget = 0, widthFrom = 0, widthTo = 0, widthT0 = 0, widthMs = 0;

  function availWidth(){
    var pcs = getComputedStyle(eqBox);
    return eqBox.clientWidth - parseFloat(pcs.paddingLeft) - parseFloat(pcs.paddingRight);
  }

  function fitFor(ms){
    fitUntil = Math.max(fitUntil, (window.performance || Date).now() + ms);
    if (!fitRAF) fitRAF = requestAnimationFrame(fitTick);
  }

  function growEquation(to, ms){
    growFrom = maxScale; growTo = to; growMs = ms;
    growT0 = (window.performance || Date).now();
    fitFor(ms + 120);
  }

  function fitTick(now){
    fitRAF = 0;
    if (widthMs){

      widthTarget = widthFrom + (widthTo - widthFrom) * ease(wu);
      if (wu >= 1){ widthMs = 0; widthTarget = widthTo; }   /* hold the width it arrived at */
    }
    if (growMs){
      var u = clamp01((now - growT0) / growMs);
      maxScale = growFrom + (growTo - growFrom) * ease(u);

  function resize(){

  function drawEdges(list, wantVisible){
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
      var e = list[i], vis = false;

      if (vis !== wantVisible) continue;
      var p = project(e.a), q = project(e.b);
      sketch(p[0], p[1], q[0], q[1], i * 7.3 + (wantVisible ? 0.4 : 91.6));
    }

  function drawDim(d, idx, ss){
    ss = ss || 1;
    if (!d) return;
    var p0 = project(d.a), pm = project(d.m), p1 = project(d.b);
    var dx = p1[0]-p0[0], dy = p1[1]-p0[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (len < 12) return;
    var ux = dx/len, uy = dy/len;
    /* push the dimension line away from the cube's centre on screen */
    var nx = -uy, ny = ux;
    var mx = (p0[0]+p1[0])/2 - cx, my = (p0[1]+p1[1])/2 - cy;
    if (nx*mx + ny*my < 0){ nx = -nx; ny = -ny; }
    var OFF = Math.max(15, 26 * ss);
    var a = [p0[0]+nx*OFF, p0[1]+ny*OFF];
    var m = [pm[0]+nx*OFF, pm[1]+ny*OFF];
    var b = [p1[0]+nx*OFF, p1[1]+ny*OFF];

    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(18, Math.round(31 * ss)) + 'px "Times New Roman", Times, serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    segment(a, m, 'A', idx * 31 + 1);
    segment(m, b, 'B', idx * 31 + 11);

    /* arrowheads point outward at the two far ends */
    arrowHead(a[0], a[1], a[0]-b[0], a[1]-b[1], idx * 31 + 21, ss);
    arrowHead(b[0], b[1], b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1], idx * 31 + 23, ss);

    /* small cross at the split */
    var tk = Math.max(4, 6 * ss);
    var tx = ux * tk, ty = uy * tk, px2 = nx * tk, py2 = ny * tk;
    sketch(m[0]-tx-px2, m[1]-ty-py2, m[0]+tx+px2, m[1]+ty+py2, idx * 31 + 25);
    sketch(m[0]-tx+px2, m[1]-ty+py2, m[0]+tx-px2, m[1]+ty-py2, idx * 31 + 27);

    ctx.restore();

    function segment(s, e, label, seed){
      var sx = e[0]-s[0], sy = e[1]-s[1], sl = Math.hypot(sx, sy) || 1;
      var vx = sx/sl, vy = sy/sl;
      var midx = (s[0]+e[0])/2, midy = (s[1]+e[1])/2;
      var gap = ctx.measureText(label).width / 2 + 9;
      if (sl > gap * 2 + 10){
        sketch(s[0], s[1], midx - vx*gap, midy - vy*gap, seed);
        sketch(midx + vx*gap, midy + vy*gap, e[0], e[1], seed + 1);
        ctx.fillText(label, midx, midy + 1);
      } else {
        sketch(s[0], s[1], e[0], e[1], seed);
        ctx.fillText(label, midx + nx * OFF * 0.8, midy + ny * OFF * 0.8 + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     The eight blocks
     ============================================================ */
  function clamp01(x){ return x < 0 ? 0 : (x > 1 ? 1 : x); }
  function ease(t){ return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3) / 2; }
  function lerp(p, q, t){ return p + (q - p) * t; }

  /* unit box topology, corners at +/- 0.5 on each axis */
  var BOX = (function(){
    var corners = [], edges = [], bfaces = [];
    function idx(i, j, k){ return i*4 + j*2 + k; }
    for (var i=0;i<2;i++) for (var j=0;j<2;j++) for (var k=0;k<2;k++)
      corners.push([i?0.5:-0.5, j?0.5:-0.5, k?0.5:-0.5]);
    for (var j1=0;j1<2;j1++) for (var k1=0;k1<2;k1++)
      edges.push({ a:idx(0,j1,k1), b:idx(1,j1,k1), f:[faceId(1,j1), faceId(2,k1)] });
    for (var i2=0;i2<2;i2++) for (var k2=0;k2<2;k2++)
      edges.push({ a:idx(i2,0,k2), b:idx(i2,1,k2), f:[faceId(0,i2), faceId(2,k2)] });
    for (var i3=0;i3<2;i3++) for (var j3=0;j3<2;j3++)
      edges.push({ a:idx(i3,j3,0), b:idx(i3,j3,1), f:[faceId(0,i3), faceId(1,j3)] });
    /* each face as four corner indices, in order around the quad */
    var ring = [[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1]];
    for (var ax=0; ax<3; ax++) for (var sd=0; sd<2; sd++){
      var u = (ax+1)%3, v = (ax+2)%3, quad = [];
      for (var r=0; r<4; r++){
        var bits = [0,0,0];
        bits[ax] = sd; bits[u] = ring[r][0]; bits[v] = ring[r][1];
        quad.push(idx(bits[0], bits[1], bits[2]));
      }
      bfaces[faceId(ax, sd)] = quad;
    }
    /* edges were pushed four at a time, one axis after another */
    var axisEdges = [edges.slice(0,4), edges.slice(4,8), edges.slice(8,12)];
    return { corners: corners, edges: edges, faces: bfaces, axisEdges: axisEdges };
  })();

  /* one block per octant; ordered a³, then the three a²b, the three ab², then b³ */
  var PIECES = [];
  for (var pi = 0; pi < 2; pi++) for (var pj = 0; pj < 2; pj++) for (var pk = 0; pk < 2; pk++){
    var sz = [pi?B:A, pj?B:A, pk?B:A];
    var og = [pi?A:0, pj?A:0, pk?A:0];
    var rt = Math.sqrt(3);
    PIECES.push({
      sz: sz,
      c: [og[0]+sz[0]/2-HALF, og[1]+sz[1]/2-HALF, og[2]+sz[2]/2-HALF],
      d: [(pi?1:-1)/rt, (pj?1:-1)/rt, (pk?1:-1)/rt],
      nb: pi + pj + pk

  }
  PIECES.sort(function(p, q){ return p.nb - q.nb; });

  /* what each block is worth: a³, a²b, ab², b³ by how many sides are b */
  var VOL = ['A\u00B3', 'A\u00B2B', 'AB\u00B2', 'B\u00B3'];
  for (var vp = 0; vp < PIECES.length; vp++) PIECES[vp].vol = VOL[PIECES[vp].nb];

  /* One measured edge, drawn straight from screen points. The cube's own
     labels go through drawDim; a block in the row has no world position to
     measure from, so it gets this instead. */
  function dimLine(pa, pb, label, ss, ctr, seed){
    var dx = pb[0]-pa[0], dy = pb[1]-pa[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (len < 10) return;
    var ux = dx/len, uy = dy/len, nx = -uy, ny = ux;
    var mx = (pa[0]+pb[0])/2 - ctr[0], my = (pa[1]+pb[1])/2 - ctr[1];
    if (nx*mx + ny*my < 0){ nx = -nx; ny = -ny; }

    var OFF = Math.max(15, 26 * ss);
    var a = [pa[0] + nx*OFF, pa[1] + ny*OFF];
    var b = [pb[0] + nx*OFF, pb[1] + ny*OFF];
    var midx = (a[0]+b[0])/2, midy = (a[1]+b[1])/2;

    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(18, Math.round(30 * ss)) + 'px "Times New Roman", Times, serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    var gap = ctx.measureText(label).width / 2 + 9;

    if (len > gap*2 + 8){
      sketch(a[0], a[1], midx - ux*gap, midy - uy*gap, seed);
      sketch(midx + ux*gap, midy + uy*gap, b[0], b[1], seed + 1);
      ctx.fillText(label, midx, midy + 1);
    } else {
      /* too short to sit inside the line — stand the label further out */
      sketch(a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1], seed);
      ctx.fillText(label, midx + nx * OFF * 0.85, midy + ny * OFF * 0.85 + 1);
    }

    arrowHead(b[0], b[1], b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1], seed + 3, ss);
  }

  /* label a block's three side lengths, each on its outermost visible edge */
  function drawBlockDims(pts, fv, pc, ss, alpha){
    var ctr = [0, 0];
    for (var v = 0; v < 8; v++){ ctr[0] += pts[v][0]; ctr[1] += pts[v][1]; }

        var mx = (pa[0]+pb[0])/2 - ctr[0], my = (pa[1]+pb[1])/2 - ctr[1];
        var sc = Math.hypot(mx, my) + 0.30*my + 0.16*mx;

  /* ============================================================

  /* An answer is checked as it goes in. The right one stays; the wrong one is

  function flashWrong(i, text){

    void el.offsetWidth;               /* restart the animation */
    el.classList.add('wrong');

  var keyCaret = document.getElementById('keycaret');

  /* sits centred over whichever box is lit, and moves with it */
  function positionKeys(){
    if (!keyRow.classList.contains('on') || selected < 0) return;
    var r = slots[selected].getBoundingClientRect();
    var w = keyRow.offsetWidth, h = keyRow.offsetHeight;
    var cxk = r.left + r.width/2;

    var x = cxk - w/2;
    x = Math.max(8, Math.min(x, window.innerWidth - w - 8));

    var y = r.top - h - 14, below = false;

    keyRow.style.transform = 'translate(' + Math.round(x) + 'px,' + Math.round(y) + 'px)';

  }

  for (var ki = 0; ki < keyBtns.length; ki++){
    keyBtns[ki].style.color = PAL.keys[ki];
    keyBtns[ki].style.borderColor = PAL.keys[ki];
  }

  function refreshKeys(){
    var show = slotsLive && selected >= 0;
    keyRow.classList.toggle('on', show);

  }

  /* ============================================================
     The finish — once every box is right
     ============================================================ */
  var pluses = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#eqinner .plus'));
  var eqDone = false, stageHidden = false, finaleTimers = [];

  function clearFinale(){
    for (var i = 0; i < finaleTimers.length; i++) clearTimeout(finaleTimers[i]);
    finaleTimers = [];
  }
  function later(fn, ms){ finaleTimers.push(setTimeout(fn, ms)); }

    for (var i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) if (answers[i] !== PIECES[i].vol) return false;
    return true;
  }

  /* width of a piece of text in a slot's own type */
  function textWidth(el, text){
    var probe = document.createElement('span');
    probe.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;visibility:hidden;white-space:nowrap;left:-9999px';
    probe.style.font = getComputedStyle(el).font;
    probe.innerHTML = termHTML(text);
    document.body.appendChild(probe);
    var w = probe.offsetWidth;
    probe.parentNode.removeChild(probe);

  var pendingGone = [], mergedMids = [];

  function mergeInto(midIdx, sideIdx, plusIdx, fullText){
    var mid = slots[midIdx];
    var midC = mid.offsetLeft + mid.offsetWidth / 2;

    for (var a = 0; a < sideIdx.length; a++){
      var el = slots[sideIdx[a]];
      var dx = midC - (el.offsetLeft + el.offsetWidth / 2);
      el.style.transform = 'translateX(' + Math.round(dx) + 'px) scale(0.78)';
      el.style.opacity = '0';
      pendingGone.push(el);
    }
    for (var b2 = 0; b2 < plusIdx.length; b2++){
      pluses[plusIdx[b2]].style.opacity = '0';
      pendingGone.push(pluses[plusIdx[b2]]);
    }

    /* the coefficient rides in at the same time, floated so it costs no width */
    var c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'coef';
    c.textContent = '3';
    mid.appendChild(c);
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){ c.classList.add('in'); });
    mergedMids.push({ el: mid, text: fullText });
  }

  /* everything tidies itself up inside the one move to the middle */
  function finalMove(){
    stageHidden = true;
    stage.classList.add('closing');
    eqInner.classList.add('closing');
    stage.style.maxHeight = '0px';
    stage.style.opacity = '0';

    /* Work out where this is going before it starts: the natural width once
       the spent terms are gone and the coefficients are in. The equation then
       travels between those two widths instead of ballooning on the way. */
    var avail = availWidth();
    var natural0 = eqInner.scrollWidth;
    var k0 = Math.min(maxScale, avail / natural0);

    var naturalFinal = natural0;
    for (var q = 0; q < pendingGone.length; q++) naturalFinal -= (pendingGone[q].offsetWidth + 5);
    for (var r = 0; r < mergedMids.length; r++){
      naturalFinal += (textWidth(mergedMids[r].el, mergedMids[r].text) + 10) - mergedMids[r].el.offsetWidth;
    }
    naturalFinal = Math.max(naturalFinal, 40);
    var kFinal = Math.min(1.9, avail / naturalFinal);

    widthFrom = k0 * natural0;
    /* never wider than it already is: the edges hold still while the terms
       draw together and the type grows into the space they leave */
    widthTo   = Math.min(kFinal * naturalFinal, widthFrom);
    widthTarget = widthFrom;
    widthT0 = (window.performance || Date).now();
    widthMs = 1900;
    fitFor(2050);

    for (var m = 0; m < mergedMids.length; m++){
      var mm = mergedMids[m];
      mm.el.innerHTML = termHTML(mm.text);         /* the floating 3 becomes real */
      mm.el.style.width = (textWidth(mm.el, mm.text) + 10) + 'px';
    }
    for (var g = 0; g < pendingGone.length; g++){
      pendingGone[g].style.width = pendingGone[g].offsetWidth + 'px';
    }
    void eqInner.offsetWidth;                     /* pin those widths first */
    for (var g2 = 0; g2 < pendingGone.length; g2++) pendingGone[g2].classList.add('eq-gone');

    eqInner.classList.add('final');
    later(function(){
      for (var h = 0; h < pendingGone.length; h++) pendingGone[h].style.display = 'none';
      fitEquation();
    }, 2050);
  }

  function runFinale(instant){
    clearFinale();
    pendingGone = []; mergedMids = [];
    var T = instant ? 0 : 1;

    selected = -1;
    slotsLive = false;                    /* no more editing: keyboard and caret go */
    refreshSlots();

    /* 1. the scaffolding falls away: "Volume =" and the boxes themselves */
    later(function(){
      /* measure "Volume =" first: collapsing from its own width means it starts
         narrowing immediately, instead of sitting still and then lurching */
      var lv = document.getElementById('lead-volume');
      lv.style.maxWidth = lv.offsetWidth + 'px';
      void lv.offsetWidth;

      eqInner.classList.add('done');
      lv.style.maxWidth = '0px';
      for (var i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) sizeToText(i, answers[i]);
      fitFor(1350);           /* follows the shrink instead of snapping twice */
    }, 900 * T);

    /* 2. the two outer a²b terms travel into the middle one, which becomes 3a²b */
    later(function(){ mergeInto(2, [1, 3], [1, 2], '3' + VOL[1]); }, 3000 * T);

    /* 3. then the same for ab² */
    later(function(){ mergeInto(5, [4, 6], [4, 5], '3' + VOL[2]); }, 6000 * T);

    /* 4. the cubes step away, the gaps close and the identity takes the middle */
    later(finalMove, 9000 * T);
  }

  function resetFinale(){
    clearFinale();
    eqDone = false;
    stageHidden = false;
    stage.style.opacity = '';
    eqInner.classList.remove('done', 'final', 'closing');
    stage.classList.remove('closing');
    document.getElementById('lead-volume').style.maxWidth = '';
    growMs = 0; widthMs = 0; widthTarget = 0; maxScale = 1;
    pendingGone = []; mergedMids = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < slots.length; i++){
      slots[i].classList.remove('eq-gone', 'pop');
      slots[i].style.display = '';
      slots[i].style.width = '';
      slots[i].style.transform = '';
      slots[i].style.opacity = '';
      slots[i].innerHTML = termHTML(answers[i] || '');
    }
    for (var j = 0; j < pluses.length; j++){
      pluses[j].classList.remove('eq-gone');
      pluses[j].style.display = '';
      pluses[j].style.opacity = '';
      pluses[j].style.width = '';
    }
    slotsLive = (STEPS[step].id === 'arranged');
    fitEquation();
  }

  function checkComplete(){
    if (eqDone || !slotsLive || !allCorrect()) return;
    eqDone = true;
    runFinale(false);
  }

  function refreshSlots(){
    refreshKeys();
    for (var i = 0; i < slots.length; i++){
      var on = slotsLive && i === selected;
      slots[i].classList.toggle('active', on);
    }
    armHint();
  }

  slots.forEach(function(el, i){
    /* tapping a box picks out its block; answers only come from the keyboard */
    el.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (!slotsLive) return;
      selected = i; refreshSlots(); draw(); emit();
    });

  /* which block is picked out, where each sits on screen, and at what scale */
  var selected = -1, hitRects = [], rowScale = 1, contentSpan = 0;

  /* draw one box from eight projected corners, with the option of a fill */
  function paintBox(pts, fv, am, strong){
    if (am > 0.02){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = (strong ? 0.30 : 0.12) * am;
      for (var f = 0; f < 6; f++){
        if (!fv[f]) continue;
        var quad = BOX.faces[f];
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (var c = 0; c < 4; c++){
          var pq = pts[quad[c]];
          if (c === 0) ctx.moveTo(pq[0], pq[1]); else ctx.lineTo(pq[0], pq[1]);
        }
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    for (var pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++){
      ctx.save();
      if (pass === 0){ ctx.setLineDash([9, 8]); ctx.lineWidth = strong ? 2.2 : 1.7; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95 * am; }
      else           { ctx.setLineDash([]);     ctx.lineWidth = strong ? 3.4 : 2.4; ctx.globalAlpha = am; }
      for (var e = 0; e < BOX.edges.length; e++){
        var ed = BOX.edges[e];
        var vis = fv[ed.f[0]] || fv[ed.f[1]];
        if (vis !== (pass === 1)) continue;
        sketch(pts[ed.a][0], pts[ed.a][1], pts[ed.b][0], pts[ed.b][1], e * 3.7 + (strong ? 61 : 0));
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     Render
     ============================================================ */
  function drawWhole(am, revOverride){
    var rev = (revOverride === undefined) ? reveal : revOverride;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.cube; ctx.fillStyle = PAL.cube;
    /* faint wash on the outward faces reads as a closed body */
    var solidity = 1 - rev;
    if (solidity > 0.01){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = solidity * 0.07 * am;
      for (var f = 0; f < faces.length; f++){
        if (!faceVisible(f)) continue;
        var qd = faces[f].q;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (var v2 = 0; v2 < 4; v2++){
          var pp = project(qd[v2]);
          if (v2 === 0) ctx.moveTo(pp[0], pp[1]); else ctx.lineTo(pp[0], pp[1]);
        }
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    /* hidden lines, dashed — these are what the reveal uncovers */
    if (rev > 0.01){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([9, 8]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.7;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95 * rev * am;
      drawEdges(edgesCut, false);
      drawEdges(edgesOuter, false);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = am;
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
    drawEdges(edgesCut, true);      /* cut lines on the faces we can see */
    drawEdges(edgesOuter, true);    /* the outline of the cube */
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* ap: 0 = assembled, 1 = laid out in a row. The blocks push apart first,
     then travel into their places in the sum. */
  function drawPieces(ap, am){
    var t1 = ease(clamp01(ap / 0.40));                 /* blocks push apart, full size */
    var t2 = ease(clamp01((ap - 0.42) / 0.40));        /* travel right, shrinking on the way */
    var t3 = ease(clamp01((ap - 0.84) / 0.16));        /* the whole cube returns on the left */
    var E  = 0.36 * S;

    /* a face of a block is in view when its normal turns toward the camera */
    var fv = [];
    for (var ax = 0; ax < 3; ax++) for (var sd = 0; sd < 2; sd++){
      var nn = [0,0,0]; nn[ax] = sd ? 1 : -1;
      fv[ax*2 + sd] = xf(R, nn)[2] < 0;
    }

    var data = [], maxH = 0;
    for (var p = 0; p < PIECES.length; p++){
      var pc = PIECES[p];
      var wc = [ pc.c[0] + pc.d[0]*E*t1, pc.c[1] + pc.d[1]*E*t1, pc.c[2] + pc.d[2]*E*t1 ];

      /* where the block actually sits in space — no scaling here, so the
         cube keeps its size all the way through the explode */
      var baseC = project(wc);

      var relBase = [], relRow = [];
      for (var v = 0; v < 8; v++){
        var lc = BOX.corners[v];
        var off = [ lc[0]*pc.sz[0], lc[1]*pc.sz[1], lc[2]*pc.sz[2] ];

        var pb = project([ wc[0]+off[0], wc[1]+off[1], wc[2]+off[2] ]);
        relBase.push([ pb[0]-baseC[0], pb[1]-baseC[1] ]);

        /* row geometry is projected about the block's own centre, so every
           block keeps its true size relative to the others */
        var pr = project(off);
        relRow.push([ pr[0] - cx, pr[1] - cy ]);
      }

      /* The slot a block occupies is its diagonal — the widest it can ever
         project to. That keeps the layout identical at every angle, so
         turning the blocks never resizes or reflows them. */
      var dia = Math.sqrt(pc.sz[0]*pc.sz[0] + pc.sz[1]*pc.sz[1] + pc.sz[2]*pc.sz[2]) * F;
      var d = { pc:pc, baseC:baseC, relBase:relBase, relRow:relRow, w:dia, h:dia };
      if (d.h > maxH) maxH = d.h;
      data.push(d);
    }

    /* the blocks settle into two rows of four on the right; the left strip is
       held back for the intact cube */
    var LEFTW = W * 0.34;
    var gcx = LEFTW + (W - LEFTW) / 2;
    var perRow = 4;
    /* the gaps carry the a/b labels of a selected block, so they need room */
    var GAP = (W - LEFTW) >= 620 ? 62 : 44, VGAP = 38;
    var rows = [];
    for (var r0 = 0; r0 < data.length; r0 += perRow) rows.push(data.slice(r0, r0 + perRow));

    var s = 1;
    for (var ri = 0; ri < rows.length; ri++){
      var sumW = 0;
      for (var q = 0; q < rows[ri].length; q++) sumW += rows[ri][q].w;
      var nGaps = rows[ri].length - 1 + (ri < rows.length - 1 ? 1 : 0);
      s = Math.min(s, ((W - LEFTW) * 0.94 - nGaps * GAP) / Math.max(sumW, 1));
    }
    s = Math.min(s, (H * 0.92 - (rows.length - 1) * VGAP) / Math.max(rows.length * maxH, 1));

    /* the same scale draws the cube on the left, so every block in the sum is
       exactly the size of its counterpart inside the cube. Measured from the
       cube's diagonal, so this too is the same at every angle. */
    var cubeDia = S * Math.sqrt(3) * F;
    s = Math.min(s, (LEFTW * 0.72) / cubeDia, (H * 0.78) / cubeDia);
    s = Math.max(s, 0.05);
    rowScale = s;

    var totalH = rows.length * maxH * s + (rows.length - 1) * VGAP;
    var rowY0 = cy - totalH/2 + maxH*s/2;

    /* how tall the finished picture actually is — the stage closes up to it
       so the equation isn't stranded below a field of white */
    if (ap >= 0.999){
      var half = Math.max(totalH, cubeDia * s) / 2 + 30;   /* 30 for the a/b labels */
      contentSpan = half * 2;
    }
    var pluses = [];
    for (var ri2 = 0; ri2 < rows.length; ri2++){
      var row = rows[ri2], sw = 0;
      for (var q2 = 0; q2 < row.length; q2++) sw += row[q2].w;
      var nG = row.length - 1 + (ri2 < rows.length - 1 ? 1 : 0);
      var x = gcx - (sw * s + nG * GAP) / 2;
      var y = rowY0 + ri2 * (maxH * s + VGAP);
      for (var q3 = 0; q3 < row.length; q3++){
        row[q3].row = [x + row[q3].w * s / 2, y];
        x += row[q3].w * s;
        var last = (ri2 === rows.length - 1) && (q3 === row.length - 1);
        if (!last){ pluses.push([x + GAP/2, y]); x += GAP; }
      }
    }

    /* draw each block, blending from where it sits in space to its place in the row */
    var pickable = (ap >= 0.999);
    var sel = pickable ? selected : -1;
    hitRects = [];
    for (var p2 = 0; p2 < data.length; p2++){
      var d2 = data[p2], pts = [];
      var bx0 = 1e9, bx1 = -1e9, by0 = 1e9, by1 = -1e9;
      for (var v3 = 0; v3 < 8; v3++){
        var rb = d2.relBase[v3], rw = d2.relRow[v3];
        var px3 = lerp(d2.baseC[0] + rb[0], d2.row[0] + rw[0] * s, t2);
        var py3 = lerp(d2.baseC[1] + rb[1], d2.row[1] + rw[1] * s, t2);
        pts.push([px3, py3]);
        if (px3 < bx0) bx0 = px3; if (px3 > bx1) bx1 = px3;
        if (py3 < by0) by0 = py3; if (py3 > by1) by1 = py3;
      }
      if (pickable) hitRects.push({ i:p2, x0:bx0-6, x1:bx1+6, y0:by0-6, y1:by1+6 });
      var fade = (sel < 0 || sel === p2) ? 1 : 0.34;
      if (carrying === p2) fade = 0.16;      /* this one is in the student's hand */
      var lit = (sel === p2 && carrying !== p2);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.blocks[p2]; ctx.fillStyle = PAL.blocks[p2];
      paintBox(pts, fv, am * fade, lit);
      ctx.restore();
      if (lit) drawBlockDims(pts, fv, d2.pc, s, am);
    }

    /* the plus signs arrive with the rows */
    if (t2 > 0.02){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = t2 * am;
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
      var L = 9;
      for (var g2 = 0; g2 < pluses.length; g2++){
        sketch(pluses[g2][0] - L, pluses[g2][1], pluses[g2][0] + L, pluses[g2][1], 200 + g2*5);
        sketch(pluses[g2][0], pluses[g2][1] - L, pluses[g2][0], pluses[g2][1] + L, 260 + g2*5);
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    /* the cube from step one comes back to stand for the whole volume,
       drawn at the same scale the blocks shrank to */
    if (t3 > 0.02){
      var keepCx = cx, keepF = F;
      cx = LEFTW * 0.44;
      F  = keepF * s;
      drawWhole(t3 * am, 0);

      /* the same block, shown where it belongs inside the cube */
      if (sel >= 0){
        var sp = PIECES[sel], spts = [];
        for (var sv = 0; sv < 8; sv++){
          var sc = BOX.corners[sv];
          spts.push(project([ sp.c[0] + sc[0]*sp.sz[0],
                              sp.c[1] + sc[1]*sp.sz[1],
                              sp.c[2] + sc[2]*sp.sz[2] ]));
        }
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.blocks[sel]; ctx.fillStyle = PAL.blocks[sel];
        paintBox(spts, fv, t3 * am, true);
        ctx.restore();
      }

      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = t3 * am;
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.3, 1.9 * s);
      for (var di = 0; di < 3; di++) drawDim(pickDim(di), di, s);
      ctx.restore();

      cx = keepCx; F = keepF;

      /* equals sign, so the two halves read as the identity they are */
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = t3 * am;
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
      var ex = LEFTW * 0.97, eL = 11;
      sketch(ex - eL, cy - 6, ex + eL, cy - 6, 310);
      sketch(ex - eL, cy + 6, ex + eL, cy + 6, 317);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  /* Once the blocks are laid out the picture is much shorter than the stage,
     so cap the stage to the picture and let the equation come up to meet it.
     Only in that step: the other steps need the full height for the cube. */
  function fitStage(){
    if (stageHidden) return;
    var want = '';
    if (apart >= 0.999 && contentSpan > 0){
      want = Math.round(contentSpan + 56) + 'px';
    }
    if (stage.style.maxHeight !== want){
      var now = parseFloat(stage.style.maxHeight) || 0, next = parseFloat(want) || 0;
      if (!want || !now || Math.abs(now - next) > 12) stage.style.maxHeight = want;
    }
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    if (apart < 0.999){ hitRects = []; stage.style.cursor = ''; }
    ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.ink;
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.ink;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

    if (apart < 0.001){
      drawWhole(1);
    } else if (apart < 0.14){
      var f2 = apart / 0.14;
      drawWhole(1 - f2);
      drawPieces(apart, f2);
    } else {
      drawPieces(apart, 1);
    }

    fitStage();
    positionKeys();

    /* dimensions belong to the intact cube; they leave as it comes apart */
    var dimAlpha = 1 - clamp01(apart / 0.28);
    if (dimAlpha > 0.01){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = dimAlpha;
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.9;
      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) drawDim(pickDim(i), i);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     Drag to rotate (with a little spin-down)
     ============================================================ */
  var dragging = false, lastX = 0, lastY = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0, raf = 0, moved = false;
  var reveal = STEPS[step].reveal, revealTarget = reveal;
  var apart = STEPS[step].apart, apartFrom = apart, apartTo = apart, apartT0 = 0;
  var APART_MS = 2300, apartDur = APART_MS;
  var K = 0.0085;
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var hint = document.getElementById('hint');

  function spin(dxr, dyr){
    R = mul(mul(rotX(-dyr), rotY(-dxr)), R);
  }

  function ensureLoop(){ if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }

  function loop(){
    raf = 0;
    var busy = false;

    if (!dragging && (Math.abs(vx) > 1e-4 || Math.abs(vy) > 1e-4)){
      spin(vx, vy);
      vx *= 0.93; vy *= 0.93;
      busy = true;
    }

    if (Math.abs(reveal - revealTarget) > 0.004){
      reveal += (revealTarget - reveal) * 0.18;
      busy = true;
    } else if (reveal !== revealTarget){
      reveal = revealTarget;
    }

    if (apart !== apartTo){
      var u = clamp01((Date.now() - apartT0) / apartDur);
      apart = apartFrom + (apartTo - apartFrom) * u;
      if (u >= 1) apart = apartTo; else busy = true;
    }

    draw();
    if (busy) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
    /* pressing on a block picks it up; pressing anywhere else turns the view */
    if (slotsLive){
      var grab = pickAt(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      if (grab >= 0){
        dragging = true; moved = false;
        grabWasSelected = (selected === grab);
        lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
        stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        if (selected !== grab){ selected = grab; refreshSlots(); draw(); }
        startCarry(grab, e.clientX, e.clientY);
        return;
      }
    }
    dragging = true; moved = false;
    lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
    vx = vy = 0;
    armHint();
    stage.classList.add('dragging');
    stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){
    if (carrying >= 0){
      if (Math.abs(e.clientX-lastX) + Math.abs(e.clientY-lastY) > 2) moved = true;
      moveCarry(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      return;
    }
    if (!dragging){
      if (hitRects.length) stage.style.cursor = (pickAt(e.clientX, e.clientY) >= 0) ? 'grab' : '';
      return;
    }
    var dx = e.clientX - lastX, dy = e.clientY - lastY;
    lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) > 2) moved = true;
    vx = dx * K; vy = dy * K;
    spin(vx, vy);
    draw();
    if (moved) hint.classList.add('gone');
  });

  function pickAt(clientX, clientY){
    var r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
    var x = clientX - r.left, y = clientY - r.top;
    for (var i = 0; i < hitRects.length; i++){
      var h = hitRects[i];
      if (x >= h.x0 && x <= h.x1 && y >= h.y0 && y <= h.y1) return h.i;
    }
    return -1;
  }

  /* ---- carrying a block down to its box ---- */
  var ghost = document.getElementById('ghost');
  var gctx = ghost.getContext('2d');
  var hintCv = document.getElementById('hintghost');
  var hctx = hintCv.getContext('2d');
  var carrying = -1, dropSlot = null, grabWasSelected = false;
  var SNAP = 95;   /* how close to the box counts as "in it" */

  /* the block's corners, projected about a point, at a given scale */
  function blockPoints(i, scale, ox, oy){
    var pc = PIECES[i], pts = [];
    for (var v = 0; v < 8; v++){
      var lc = BOX.corners[v];
      var q = xf(R, [ lc[0]*pc.sz[0], lc[1]*pc.sz[1], lc[2]*pc.sz[2] ]);
      pts.push([ ox + q[0]*F*scale, oy - q[1]*F*scale ]);
    }
    return pts;
  }

  /* paint one block onto a floating canvas, sized to fit it */
  function renderGhost(canvasEl, gc, i, scale){
    var pts = blockPoints(i, scale, 0, 0);
    var mnx = 1e9, mxx = -1e9, mny = 1e9, mxy = -1e9;
    for (var v = 0; v < 8; v++){
      if (pts[v][0] < mnx) mnx = pts[v][0]; if (pts[v][0] > mxx) mxx = pts[v][0];
      if (pts[v][1] < mny) mny = pts[v][1]; if (pts[v][1] > mxy) mxy = pts[v][1];
    }
    var pad = 8, w = (mxx - mnx) + pad*2, h = (mxy - mny) + pad*2;
    canvasEl.style.width = w + 'px'; canvasEl.style.height = h + 'px';
    canvasEl.width = Math.round(w * DPR); canvasEl.height = Math.round(h * DPR);
    gc.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
    gc.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    gc.strokeStyle = PAL.blocks[i]; gc.fillStyle = PAL.blocks[i];
    gc.lineCap = 'round'; gc.lineJoin = 'round';

    var fv = [];
    for (var ax = 0; ax < 3; ax++) for (var sd = 0; sd < 2; sd++){
      var nn = [0,0,0]; nn[ax] = sd ? 1 : -1;
      fv[ax*2 + sd] = xf(R, nn)[2] < 0;
    }
    var keep = ctx; ctx = gc;            /* reuse the same hand-drawn strokes */
    paintBox(blockPoints(i, scale, -mnx + pad, -mny + pad), fv, 1, true);
    ctx = keep;
    return [w, h];
  }

  function slotCentre(i){
    if (i < 0 || i >= slots.length) return null;
    var r = slots[i].getBoundingClientRect();
    return [r.left + r.width/2, r.top + r.height/2];
  }

  function blockCentre(i){
    for (var k = 0; k < hitRects.length; k++){
      if (hitRects[k].i !== i) continue;
      var r = stage.getBoundingClientRect(), h = hitRects[k];
      return [r.left + (h.x0 + h.x1)/2, r.top + (h.y0 + h.y1)/2];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function startCarry(i, clientX, clientY){
    carrying = i;
    clearTimeout(hintTimer); hintTimer = 0;
    stopHint();
    renderGhost(ghost, gctx, i, rowScale * 0.78);
    ghost.style.display = 'block';
    moveCarry(clientX, clientY);
    draw();
  }

  function moveCarry(clientX, clientY){
    /* near enough to its box, the block settles into it on its own */
    var target = slotCentre(carrying);
    var near = target && Math.hypot(clientX - target[0], clientY - target[1]) < SNAP;
    var x = near ? target[0] : clientX;
    var y = near ? target[1] : clientY;

    ghost.style.transform = 'translate(' +
      (x - ghost.offsetWidth/2) + 'px,' + (y - ghost.offsetHeight/2) + 'px)' +
      (near ? ' scale(0.82)' : '');

    var want = near ? slots[carrying] : null;
    if (!want){
      var over = slotUnder(clientX, clientY);
      if (over && +over.getAttribute('data-slot') === carrying) want = over;
    }
    if (want !== dropSlot){
      if (dropSlot) dropSlot.classList.remove('drop');
      dropSlot = want;
      if (dropSlot) dropSlot.classList.add('drop');
    }
  }

  function slotUnder(clientX, clientY){
    var el = document.elementFromPoint(clientX, clientY);
    while (el && el !== document.body){
      if (el.classList && el.classList.contains('slot')) return el;
      el = el.parentNode;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function endCarry(clientX, clientY){
    if (dropSlot){
      dropSlot.classList.remove('drop');
      submitAnswer(carrying, PIECES[carrying].vol);
    }
    ghost.style.display = 'none';
    ghost.style.transform = '';
    dropSlot = null; carrying = -1;
    refreshSlots(); draw(); emit();
  }

  /* ---- showing the gesture, for anyone who hasn't spotted it ---- */
  var hintRAF = 0, hintFor = -1, hintStart = 0, hintTimer = 0;
  var hasFilledOne = false;      /* once they've done it once, they know how */
  var HINT_WAIT = 10000;

  function stopHint(){
    if (hintRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(hintRAF);
    hintRAF = 0; hintFor = -1;
    hintCv.style.display = 'none';
    hintCv.style.opacity = 0;
  }

  /* wait out ten quiet seconds before offering to show the move.
     Any activity restarts the wait; a first answer retires the hint for good. */
  function armHint(){
    clearTimeout(hintTimer); hintTimer = 0;
    stopHint();
    if (reduceMotion || hasFilledOne) return;
    if (!slotsLive || selected < 0 || answers[selected] || carrying >= 0) return;
    hintTimer = setTimeout(startHint, HINT_WAIT);
  }

  function startHint(){
    if (reduceMotion || hasFilledOne) return;
    if (!slotsLive || selected < 0 || carrying >= 0 || answers[selected]) return;
    if (!blockCentre(selected) || !slotCentre(selected)) return;
    if (hintRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(hintRAF);
    hintFor = selected;
    renderGhost(hintCv, hctx, selected, rowScale * 0.78);
    hintCv.style.display = 'block';
    hintStart = 0;
    hintRAF = requestAnimationFrame(hintTick);
  }

  function hintTick(now){
    hintRAF = 0;
    if (hintFor !== selected || carrying >= 0 || !slotsLive || answers[selected]){ stopHint(); return; }
    if (!hintStart) hintStart = now;

    var TRIP = 1400, REST = 500, CYCLES = 3;
    var elapsed = now - hintStart;
    if (elapsed > (TRIP + REST) * CYCLES){ stopHint(); return; }

    var t = clamp01((elapsed % (TRIP + REST)) / TRIP);
    var from = blockCentre(selected), to = slotCentre(selected);
    if (!from || !to){ stopHint(); return; }

    var e = ease(t);
    var x = from[0] + (to[0] - from[0]) * e;
    var y = from[1] + (to[1] - from[1]) * e;
    var scale = 1 - 0.18 * e;
    hintCv.style.opacity = 0.5 * Math.min(1, t/0.15) * Math.min(1, (1 - t)/0.15);
    hintCv.style.transform = 'translate(' +
      (x - hintCv.offsetWidth/2) + 'px,' + (y - hintCv.offsetHeight/2) + 'px) scale(' + scale + ')';

    hintRAF = requestAnimationFrame(hintTick);
  }

  function endDrag(e){
    if (carrying >= 0){
      dragging = false;
      stage.classList.remove('dragging');
      try { stage.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
      if (!moved){
        /* a tap, not a carry: tapping the same block again puts it back */
        ghost.style.display = 'none';
        if (dropSlot){ dropSlot.classList.remove('drop'); dropSlot = null; }
        carrying = -1;
        if (grabWasSelected) selected = -1;
        refreshSlots(); draw(); emit();
      } else {
        endCarry(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!dragging) return;
    dragging = false;
    stage.classList.remove('dragging');
    try { stage.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}

    /* tapping empty space clears the selection */
    if (!moved && slotsLive && selected >= 0){
      selected = -1;
      refreshSlots(); draw();

    emit();

  stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);

  stage.addEventListener('dblclick', function(){ resetView(); });

  /* keyboard nudge for accessibility */
  stage.tabIndex = 0;
  stage.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    var s = 0.09, used = true;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')       spin(-s, 0);
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') spin(s, 0);
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp')    spin(0, -s);
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown')  spin(0, s);
    else used = false;
    if (used){ e.preventDefault(); draw(); hint.classList.add('gone'); emit(); }
  });

  /* ============================================================
     Step controls — wired but inert until step 2 exists
     ============================================================ */
  var prevBtn  = document.getElementById('prev'),
      nextBtn  = document.getElementById('next'),
      resetBtn = document.getElementById('reset');

  /* each step can define its own starting orientation; reset returns to that one */
  function homeFor(i){ return (STEPS[i] && STEPS[i].home) ? STEPS[i].home() : HOME(); }

  function applyStep(animate){
    prevBtn.disabled = step <= 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = step >= STEPS.length - 1;
    revealTarget = STEPS[step].reveal;
    selected = -1;
    slotsLive = (STEPS[step].id === 'arranged');
    resetFinale();
    refreshSlots();
    if (slotsLive) setTimeout(checkComplete, 0);
    var wantApart = STEPS[step].apart;
    if (animate && !reduceMotion){
      if (wantApart !== apartTo){
        apartFrom = apart; apartTo = wantApart; apartT0 = Date.now();
        /* a short hop between steps shouldn't take as long as the full move */
        apartDur = Math.max(650, APART_MS * Math.abs(apartTo - apartFrom));
      }
      ensureLoop();
    } else {
      reveal = revealTarget;
      apart = apartFrom = apartTo = wantApart;
      draw();
    }
    /* future: fill the equation slots per STEPS[step] */
  }

  function resetView(){
    R = homeFor(step);
    vx = vy = 0;
    draw();
    emit();
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click',  function(){ if (step > 0){ step--; applyStep(true); emit(); } });
  nextBtn.addEventListener('click',  function(){ if (step < STEPS.length - 1){ step++; applyStep(true); emit(); } });
  resetBtn.addEventListener('click', resetView);
  applyStep(false);

  /* ============================================================
     GeoShift live-sync contract
     ============================================================ */
  function getState(){
    return { model: MODEL, step: step, R: R.slice(), selected: selected, answers: answers.slice() };
  }

  function setState(st){
    if (!st) return;
    if (typeof st.step === 'number' && st.step >= 0 && st.step < STEPS.length){
      step = st.step; applyStep(false);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(st.R) && st.R.length === 9) R = st.R.slice();
    if (typeof st.selected === 'number') selected = st.selected;
    if (Array.isArray(st.answers)){
      resetFinale();
      for (var ai = 0; ai < slots.length; ai++) setSlot(ai, st.answers[ai] || '');
    }
    refreshSlots();
    draw();
    checkComplete();
  }

  var emitTimer = 0;
  function emit(){
    clearTimeout(emitTimer);
    emitTimer = setTimeout(function(){
      var s = getState();
      try { if (typeof window.__liveSyncEmit === 'function') window.__liveSyncEmit(s); } catch (e) {}
      try { if (window.parent && window.parent !== window)
        window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'state', data: s }, '*'); } catch (e) {}
    }, 120);
  }

  window.getState = getState;
  window.setState = setState;
  window.__modelName = MODEL;

  window.addEventListener('message', function(e){
    var d = e && e.data;
    if (!d || typeof d !== 'object') return;
    if (d.type === 'setState') setState(d.data || d.state);
    else if (d.type === 'getState'){
      try { e.source && e.source.postMessage({ type:'state', data:getState() }, '*'); } catch (err) {}
    }
  });

  /* ============================================================
     Boot
     ============================================================ */
  stage.addEventListener('transitionend', function(e){
    if (e.propertyName === 'max-height') positionKeys();
  });
  if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(stage);
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(draw);
  setTimeout(function(){ hint.classList.add('gone'); }, 6000);

})();

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var MODEL = 'rover-coding-challenge';

  /* ============================================================
     The level
       Rocks block every straight route, so the only way across is a
       staircase — which makes the tidy answer
         repeat 5 times [ move forward, turn left, move forward, turn right ]
     ============================================================ */
  var COLS = 6, ROWS = 6, PAR = 5;
  var START = { c:0, r:5, dir:0 };                 /* 0=E 1=S 2=W 3=N */
  var FLAG  = { c:5, r:0 };
  var ROCKS = [[0,4],[2,5],[3,4],[4,3],[5,2]];
  var DIRS  = [[1,0],[0,1],[-1,0],[0,-1]];

  function isRock(c, r){
    for (var i = 0; i < ROCKS.length; i++) if (ROCKS[i][0] === c && ROCKS[i][1] === r) return true;
    return false;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     The program:  [{t:'F'|'L'|'R'} | {t:'REP', n, body:[...]}]
     ============================================================ */
  var script = [];

  var OPTS = {
    MOVE: { kw:'move', cls:'k-move', opts:[['F','forward'],['B','backward']] },
    TURN: { kw:'turn', cls:'k-turn', opts:[['L','left'],   ['R','right']]    }
  };

  function optionsHTML(t, d){
    var o = OPTS[t].opts, out = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < o.length; i++)
      out += '<option value="' + o[i][0] + '"' + (o[i][0] === d ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + o[i][1] + '</option>';
    return out;
  }

  function lineCount(){
    var n = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < script.length; i++){
      n++;
      if (script[i].t === 'REP') n += script[i].body.length;
    }
    return n;
  }

  function flatten(){
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < script.length; i++){
      var b = script[i];
      if (b.t === 'REP'){
        for (var k = 0; k < b.n; k++)
          for (var j = 0; j < b.body.length; j++)
            out.push({ t:b.body[j].t, d:b.body[j].d, path:[i, j] });
      } else out.push({ t:b.t, d:b.d, path:[i] });
      if (out.length > 400) break;
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     The world
     ============================================================ */
  var cv = document.getElementById('cv'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  var world = document.getElementById('world');
  var W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1, CELL = 40, OX = 0, OY = 0;

  var rover = { c:START.c, r:START.r, dir:START.dir, x:START.c, y:START.r, ang:0, bump:0 };
  var trail = [];

  function layout(){
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = Math.max(1, r.width); H = Math.max(1, r.height);
    cv.width = Math.round(W * DPR); cv.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    /* scale by what the backing store actually is, not by what we asked for,
       or every line lands on a slightly different fraction of a pixel */
    ctx.setTransform(cv.width / W, 0, 0, cv.height / H, 0, 0);
    /* a thin band of ground is left top and bottom for the two labels */
    CELL = Math.floor(Math.min(W / COLS, (H - 84) / ROWS));
    OX = Math.round((W - CELL * COLS) / 2);
    OY = Math.round((H - CELL * ROWS) / 2);
  }

  function cellX(c){ return OX + c * CELL + CELL/2; }
  function cellY(r){ return OY + r * CELL + CELL/2; }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, rad){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + rad, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, rad);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, rad);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, rad);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, rad);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  /* ============================================================
     The ground — flat shapes, the way an illustrator would paint it
     ============================================================ */
  function rnd(n){ var x = Math.sin(n * 127.1) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x); }

  var SAND = { base:'#D8A86F', pale:'#EBCF9F', dark:'#C08C55' };

  /* a closed organic shape, smoothed through its own points */
  function blob(cx0, cy0, rad, wob, seed, n){
    n = n || 9;
    var pts = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++){
      var a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2;
      var rr = rad * (1 - wob/2 + rnd(seed + i * 3.7) * wob);
      pts.push([cx0 + Math.cos(a) * rr, cy0 + Math.sin(a) * rr * 0.86]);
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    var mx = (pts[n-1][0] + pts[0][0]) / 2, my = (pts[n-1][1] + pts[0][1]) / 2;
    ctx.moveTo(mx, my);
    for (var j = 0; j < n; j++){
      var cur = pts[j], nxt = pts[(j+1) % n];
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cur[0], cur[1], (cur[0] + nxt[0]) / 2, (cur[1] + nxt[1]) / 2);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawTerrain(){
    ctx.save();

    ctx.fillStyle = SAND.base;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    /* broad tonal patches */
    var tints = ['#E3BE8A', '#C99160', '#EBCF9F', '#CE9C68'];
    for (var i = 0; i < 11; i++){
      ctx.fillStyle = tints[i % tints.length];
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.62;
      blob(rnd(i*2.1) * W, rnd(i*4.3) * H, (0.16 + rnd(i*6.1) * 0.22) * Math.min(W, H), 0.55, i * 11, 10);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    /* the pale swashes: some wander across, some wander down */
    var M = Math.min(W, H);
    for (var k = 0; k < 3; k++){
      var vertical = (k === 1);
      var wide = M * (0.075 + rnd(k*9) * 0.06);
      ctx.beginPath();
      if (vertical){
        var x0 = (0.18 + rnd(k*4.1) * 0.7) * W;
        ctx.moveTo(x0, -40);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(x0 + W*0.26, H*0.28, x0 - W*0.30, H*0.66, x0 + W*0.10, H + 40);
      } else {
        var yy = (0.18 + k * 0.42) * H + rnd(k*17) * H * 0.05;
        var amp = H * (0.10 + rnd(k*5) * 0.16);
        ctx.moveTo(-40, yy);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(W*0.22, yy - amp, W*0.58, yy + amp, W + 40, yy - amp*0.55);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(248,230,196,.30)';
      ctx.lineWidth = wide;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.stroke();

      /* the fine line that runs along one edge of the swash */
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(vertical ? -wide*0.40 : 0, vertical ? 0 : -wide*0.40);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,250,238,.50)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    /* pebbles — small and flat, so they are never mistaken for craters */
    for (var q = 0; q < 26; q++){
      var px = rnd(q*3.9) * W, py = rnd(q*8.3) * H, pr = Math.min(W,H) * (0.004 + rnd(q*2.7)*0.007);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,106,62,.55)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px, py, pr*1.3, pr, rnd(q)*3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBackdrop(){ drawTerrain(); }

  /* the survey grid, ruled right across the land */
  function drawBoard(){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(92,52,22,.26)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    for (var c = 0; c <= COLS; c++){
      var gx = OX + c*CELL + 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gx, 0); ctx.lineTo(gx, H); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (var r = 0; r <= ROWS; r++){
      var gy = OY + r*CELL + 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, gy); ctx.lineTo(W, gy); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* START and GOAL, inside the corners of their own squares */
  function badge(text, cx0, cy0){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = '800 ' + Math.round(Math.max(11, Math.min(17, CELL*0.17))) +
               'px Nunito,"Baloo 2","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif';
    var w = ctx.measureText(text).width + 20, h = Math.max(21, Math.min(28, CELL*0.25));
    cx0 = Math.max(w/2 + 8, Math.min(W - w/2 - 8, cx0));      /* never let it run off */
    cy0 = Math.max(h/2 + 5, Math.min(H - h/2 - 5, cy0));
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(44,20,6,.78)';
    roundRect(cx0 - w/2, cy0 - h/2, w, h, h/2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,235,205,.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFEFD8';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(text, cx0, cy0 + 1);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawLabels(){
    badge('START', cellX(START.c), OY + ROWS*CELL + (H - OY - ROWS*CELL) / 2);
    badge('GOAL',  cellX(FLAG.c),  OY / 2);
  }

  function drawTrail(){
    if (trail.length < 2) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,24,12,.34)';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(4, CELL*0.13);
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cellX(trail[0][0]), cellY(trail[0][1]));
    for (var i = 1; i < trail.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(cellX(trail[i][0]), cellY(trail[i][1]));
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* A crater lit from the upper left: the near wall falls into shadow, the far
     wall catches the light, and the rim crest does the opposite. */
  function drawCraters(){
    ctx.save();
    for (var i = 0; i < ROCKS.length; i++){
      var x = cellX(ROCKS[i][0]), y = cellY(ROCKS[i][1]);
      var r = CELL * 0.33;
      var seed = i * 31 + 5;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x, y);
      ctx.rotate(rnd(seed) * Math.PI);

      /* ejecta thrown out around the rim */
      for (var e = 0; e < 7; e++){
        var ea = rnd(seed + e*2.3) * Math.PI * 2;
        var ed = r * (1.25 + rnd(seed + e*4.7) * 0.55);
        var er = r * (0.035 + rnd(seed + e*6.1) * 0.05);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,84,50,.30)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(Math.cos(ea)*ed, Math.sin(ea)*ed, er, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }

      /* the raised rim, a ring rather than a disc */
      ctx.fillStyle = '#E8C99A';
      blob(0, 0, r * 1.16, 0.10, seed + 1, 13); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#EFD9B0';                       /* crest, catching the sun */
      blob(-r*0.045, -r*0.045, r * 1.08, 0.10, seed + 2, 13); ctx.fill();

      /* the bowl */
      ctx.save();
      blob(0, 0, r, 0.09, seed + 3, 13);
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#A97C4E';
      ctx.fillRect(-r*1.4, -r*1.4, r*2.8, r*2.8);

      /* near wall in shadow */
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6F4E2D';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-r*0.30, -r*0.30, r*1.05, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      /* far wall taking the light */
      ctx.fillStyle = '#C08F58';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r*0.52, r*0.52, r*0.78, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      /* the floor, settled at the bottom */
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8A6540';
      blob(r*0.06, r*0.06, r*0.46, 0.14, seed + 4, 11); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();

      /* rim shading: dark where the crest turns away from the sun */
      ctx.save();
      blob(0, 0, r * 1.16, 0.10, seed + 1);
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,80,44,.34)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r*0.55, r*0.55, r*1.0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* the mission base from above: dishes, arrays and a round control building */
  function drawFlag(){
    var x = cellX(FLAG.c), y = cellY(FLAG.r), u = CELL;

    ctx.save();

    /* the cleared apron */
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(190,205,215,.14)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, u*0.46, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(14,165,201,.50)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, u*0.46, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    /* two solar arrays */
    function array(ax, ay, rot){
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(ax, ay); ctx.rotate(rot);
      var w = u*0.20, h = u*0.105;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2C5C72'; ctx.fillRect(-w/2, -h/2, w, h);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#7FC4D8'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (var i = 1; i < 4; i++){
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-w/2 + i*w/4, -h/2); ctx.lineTo(-w/2 + i*w/4, h/2); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-w/2, 0); ctx.lineTo(w/2, 0); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#8FA3B4'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      ctx.strokeRect(-w/2, -h/2, w, h);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    array(x - u*0.34, y + u*0.20, -0.35);
    array(x + u*0.34, y + u*0.20,  0.35);

    /* dishes, tipped up towards the sky */
    function dish(dx, dy, rot){
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(dx, dy); ctx.rotate(rot);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6F8091'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, u*0.022);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, u*0.06); ctx.lineTo(0, -u*0.02); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#D7E2EA';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, -u*0.035, u*0.095, u*0.062, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5B6C7D'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#9FB2C0';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, -u*0.035, u*0.055, u*0.034, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3CE2E8';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -u*0.035, u*0.013, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    dish(x - u*0.30, y - u*0.24, -0.5);
    dish(x + u*0.30, y - u*0.24,  0.5);
    dish(x,          y - u*0.36,  0);

    /* the control building */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#93A6B6';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, u*0.245, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4E5F70'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, u*0.02); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(78,95,112,.75)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    for (var k = 0; k < 8; k++){
      var a = k * Math.PI/4 + Math.PI/8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + Math.cos(a)*u*0.115, y + Math.sin(a)*u*0.115);
      ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a)*u*0.245, y + Math.sin(a)*u*0.245);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#DCE6EE';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, u*0.155, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5B6C7D'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.stroke();

    /* a beacon on the roof */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#D9486F';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - u*0.10, u*0.022, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawRover(){
    var x = cellX(0) + rover.x * CELL + (rover.bump ? Math.cos(rover.ang) * rover.bump : 0);
    var y = cellY(0) + rover.y * CELL + (rover.bump ? Math.sin(rover.ang) * rover.bump : 0);
    var s = CELL * 0.32;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(rover.ang);
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(160,190,255,.45)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#EEF2FF';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#9E9CEA'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.2; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    roundRect(-s, -s*0.8, s*1.8, s*1.6, s*0.4);
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5A57D6';
    roundRect(-s*0.78, -s*1.05, s*0.5, s*0.28, 3); ctx.fill();
    roundRect(-s*0.78,  s*0.77, s*0.5, s*0.28, 3); ctx.fill();
    roundRect( s*0.22, -s*1.05, s*0.5, s*0.28, 3); ctx.fill();
    roundRect( s*0.22,  s*0.77, s*0.5, s*0.28, 3); ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#4340B4';
    roundRect(s*0.12, -s*0.42, s*0.62, s*0.84, s*0.2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#BFE9FF';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s*0.52, 0, s*0.16, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawBackdrop(); drawBoard(); drawLabels(); drawTrail(); drawFlag(); drawCraters(); drawRover();
  }

  /* ============================================================
     Rendering the program as numbered lines
     ============================================================ */
  var codeEl = document.getElementById('code');
  var trayEl = document.getElementById('tray');
  var ghost = document.getElementById('ghost');

  function stmtHTML(b){
    if (b.t === 'REP'){
      return '<span class="kw k-rep">repeat</span>' +
             '<button class="stp" data-act="dec">−</button>' +
             '<span class="chip">' + b.n + ' times</span>' +
             '<button class="stp" data-act="inc">+</button>';
    }
    var o = OPTS[b.t];
    return '<span class="kw ' + o.cls + '">' + o.kw + '</span>' +
           '<select class="chip">' + optionsHTML(b.t, b.d) + '</select>';
  }

  function makeLine(b, path, depth, num){
    var line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'line' + (depth ? ' d' + depth : '');
    line.setAttribute('data-path', path.join(','));

    var n = document.createElement('span');
    n.className = 'num'; n.textContent = num;
    line.appendChild(n);

    var st = document.createElement('div');
    st.className = 'stmt s-' + b.t;
    st.innerHTML = '<span class="grip"></span>' + stmtHTML(b) +
                   '<button class="kill" data-act="del">×</button>';
    line.appendChild(st);
    return line;
  }

  function render(){
    codeEl.innerHTML = '';
    var num = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < script.length; i++){
      var b = script[i];
      codeEl.appendChild(makeLine(b, [i], 0, ++num));
      if (b.t === 'REP')
        for (var j = 0; j < b.body.length; j++)
          codeEl.appendChild(makeLine(b.body[j], [i, j], 1, ++num));

  function makeTray(){
    ['MOVE','TURN','REP'].forEach(function(t){
      var d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'tile';
      /* the tray carries plain labels: a dropdown here would swallow the drag,
         and the choice belongs to the line once it is in the program */
      d.innerHTML = (t === 'REP')
        ? '<span class="kw k-rep">repeat</span><span class="chip">n times</span>'
        : '<span class="kw ' + OPTS[t].cls + '">' + OPTS[t].kw + '</span>' +

  /* a dropdown changes the line it sits in */
  codeEl.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    if (!e.target.matches || !e.target.matches('select.chip')) return;
    var p = e.target.closest('.line').getAttribute('data-path').split(',').map(Number);
    var ref = atPath(p);
    ref.list[ref.i].d = e.target.value;
    stopMsg(); emit();
  });

  function updateRun(){
    document.getElementById('run').disabled = (lineCount() === 0) || running;
  }

  function atPath(p){
    if (p.length === 1) return { list:script, i:p[0] };
    return { list:script[p[0]].body, i:p[1] };
  }

  codeEl.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var btn = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-act]') : null;
    if (!btn || running) return;
    var p = btn.closest('.line').getAttribute('data-path').split(',').map(Number);
    var ref = atPath(p), act = btn.getAttribute('data-act');
    if (act === 'del') ref.list.splice(ref.i, 1);
    else {
      var b = ref.list[ref.i];
      b.n = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, b.n + (act === 'inc' ? 1 : -1)));
    }
    stopMsg(); render(); emit();
