  /* ============================================================
     Dragging lines
     ============================================================ */
  var drag = null, insBar = null;

  function showIns(beforeEl, depth){
    if (!insBar){ insBar = document.createElement('div'); insBar.id = 'ins'; }
    insBar.style.marginLeft = (46 + (depth ? 20 : 0)) + 'px';
    if (beforeEl) codeEl.insertBefore(insBar, beforeEl);
    else codeEl.appendChild(insBar);
  }
  function hideIns(){ if (insBar && insBar.parentNode) insBar.parentNode.removeChild(insBar); }

  /* Where would this land? The line above the pointer decides the position,
     and how far right the pointer is decides whether it goes inside a repeat
     or back out at the top level. */
  function dropTarget(x, y){
    var r = codeEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (x < r.left - 10 || x > r.right + 10 || y < r.top - 10 || y > r.bottom + 10) return null;

    var lines = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < codeEl.children.length; i++)
      if (codeEl.children[i].classList.contains('line')) lines.push(codeEl.children[i]);

    var idx = lines.length;
    for (var j = 0; j < lines.length; j++){
      var lr = lines[j].getBoundingClientRect();
      if (y < lr.top + lr.height/2){ idx = j; break; }
    }

    var above = idx > 0 ? lines[idx-1].getAttribute('data-path').split(',').map(Number) : null;
    var isRep = drag && drag.payload.t === 'REP';
    var indented = x >= r.left + 40;            /* aim left to come back out */

    if (above && !isRep && indented){
      if (above.length === 1 && script[above[0]].t === 'REP')
        return { list:script[above[0]].body, index:0, depth:1, before:lines[idx] || null };
      if (above.length === 2)
        return { list:script[above[0]].body, index:above[1] + 1, depth:1, before:lines[idx] || null };
    }

    /* top level: after whichever block the line above belongs to, which means
       the bar has to skip past that block's body lines */
    var top = above ? above[0] + 1 : 0;
    var before = null;
    for (var k = 0; k < lines.length; k++){
      var pp = lines[k].getAttribute('data-path').split(',').map(Number);
      if (pp[0] >= top){ before = lines[k]; break; }
    }
    return { list:script, index:top, depth:0, before:before };
  }

  function startDrag(e, payload, fromPath){
    drag = { payload:payload, from:fromPath };
    ghost.innerHTML = '';
    var st = document.createElement('div');
    st.className = 'stmt s-' + payload.t;
    st.innerHTML = stmtHTML(payload);
    ghost.appendChild(st);
    ghost.style.display = 'block';
    moveGhost(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  }
  function moveGhost(x, y){
    ghost.style.transform = 'translate(' + (x - 40) + 'px,' + (y - 18) + 'px)';
  }

  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
    if (running) return;
    if (e.target.closest && (e.target.closest('[data-act]') || e.target.closest('select'))) return;

    var tile = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.tile') : null;
    if (tile){
      var t = tile.getAttribute('data-new');
      var payload;
      if (t === 'REP') payload = { t:'REP', n:2, body:[] };
      else payload = { t:t, d: OPTS[t].opts[0][0] };
      startDrag(e, payload, null);
      e.preventDefault(); return;
    }
    var line = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.line') : null;
    if (line && codeEl.contains(line)){
      var p = line.getAttribute('data-path').split(',').map(Number);
      var ref = atPath(p);
      startDrag(e, ref.list[ref.i], p);
      line.style.opacity = .35;
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){
    if (!drag) return;
    moveGhost(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    var t = dropTarget(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    codeEl.classList.toggle('over', !!t);
    if (t) showIns(t.before, t.depth); else hideIns();
  });

  document.addEventListener('pointerup', function(e){
    if (!drag) return;
    ghost.style.display = 'none';
    hideIns();
    codeEl.classList.remove('over');
    var t = dropTarget(e.clientX, e.clientY);

    if (drag.from){
      var ref = atPath(drag.from);
      var taken = ref.list.splice(ref.i, 1)[0];
      if (t){
        var idx = t.index;
        if (t.list === ref.list && idx > ref.i) idx--;
        t.list.splice(idx, 0, taken);
      }
    } else if (t){
      t.list.splice(t.index, 0, drag.payload);
    }
    drag = null;
    stopMsg(); render(); emit();
  });

  /* ============================================================
     Running
     ============================================================ */
  var runBtn = document.getElementById('run'), resetBtn = document.getElementById('reset');
  var msg = document.getElementById('msg'), tickMark = document.getElementById('tick');
  var running = false, steps = [], ip = 0, anim = null, raf = 0, last = 0;

  function stopMsg(){ msg.classList.remove('on','bad','good'); tickMark.classList.remove('on'); }

  function say(text, good){
    msg.textContent = text; msg.classList.add('on');
    msg.classList.toggle('good', !!good); msg.classList.toggle('bad', !good);
  }

  function mark(path, cls){
    var all = codeEl.querySelectorAll('.line');
    for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) all[i].classList.remove('run');
    if (!path) return;
    var el = codeEl.querySelector('[data-path="' + path.join(',') + '"]');
    if (el) el.classList.add(cls || 'run');
  }

  function resetRover(){
    rover.c = START.c; rover.r = START.r; rover.dir = START.dir;
    rover.x = START.c; rover.y = START.r; rover.ang = 0; rover.bump = 0;
    trail = [[START.c, START.r]];
    var all = codeEl.querySelectorAll('.line');
    for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) all[i].classList.remove('run','bad');
    draw();
  }

  function startRun(){
    if (running || lineCount() === 0) return;
    stopMsg(); resetRover();
    steps = flatten(); ip = 0; running = true;
    updateRun(); runBtn.disabled = true;
    nextStep(); emit();
  }

  function finish(text, good, path){
    running = false;
    mark(null);
    if (path){
      var el = codeEl.querySelector('[data-path="' + path.join(',') + '"]');
      if (el) el.classList.add('bad');
    }
    if (good){
      tickMark.classList.add('on');
      var n = lineCount();
      say(n <= PAR ? ('Solved in ' + n + ' lines!')
                   : ('Solved in ' + n + ' lines — can you do it in ' + PAR + '?'), true);
    } else say(text, false);
    updateRun(); emit();
  }

  function nextStep(){
    if (!running) return;
    if (rover.c === FLAG.c && rover.r === FLAG.r) return finish('', true);
    if (ip >= steps.length) return finish('The rover stopped short.', false);

    var st = steps[ip++];
    mark(st.path);

    if (st.t === 'MOVE'){
      var sign = (st.d === 'B') ? -1 : 1;
      var d = DIRS[rover.dir];
      var nc = rover.c + d[0]*sign, nr = rover.r + d[1]*sign;
      var offMap = (nc < 0 || nc >= COLS || nr < 0 || nr >= ROWS);
      if (offMap || isRock(nc, nr)){
        anim = { kind:'bump', t:0, dur:420, path:st.path, why:offMap ? 'edge' : 'crater' };
      } else {
        anim = { kind:'move', t:0, dur:330, fc:rover.c, fr:rover.r, tc:nc, tr:nr };
        rover.c = nc; rover.r = nr;
        trail.push([nc, nr]);
      }
    } else {
      var turn = (st.d === 'R') ? 1 : -1;
      rover.dir = (rover.dir + turn + 4) % 4;
      anim = { kind:'turn', t:0, dur:280, from:rover.ang, to:rover.ang + turn * Math.PI/2 };
    }
    if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function tick(now){
    raf = 0;
    var dt = last ? Math.min(50, now - last) : 16; last = now;
    if (anim){
      anim.t += dt;
      var u = Math.min(1, anim.t / anim.dur);
      var e = u < .5 ? 2*u*u : 1 - Math.pow(-2*u + 2, 2)/2;
      if (anim.kind === 'move'){
        rover.x = anim.fc + (anim.tc - anim.fc) * e;
        rover.y = anim.fr + (anim.tr - anim.fr) * e;
      } else if (anim.kind === 'turn'){
        rover.ang = anim.from + (anim.to - anim.from) * e;
      } else {
        rover.bump = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * CELL * 0.22;
      }
      draw();
      if (u >= 1){
        var was = anim; rover.bump = 0; anim = null;
        if (was.kind === 'bump'){
          draw();
          return finish(was.why === 'edge' ? 'The rover ran off the edge of the map.'
                                           : 'Ouch — the rover drove into a crater.', false, was.path);
        }
        setTimeout(nextStep, 70);
      }
    }
    if (anim || running) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  runBtn.addEventListener('click', startRun);
  resetBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    running = false; anim = null;
    stopMsg(); resetRover(); updateRun(); emit();
  });

  /* ============================================================
     Live-sync contract
     ============================================================ */
  function getState(){ return { model:MODEL, script:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(script)), running:running }; }
  function setState(st){
    if (!st) return;
    if (Array.isArray(st.script)){ script = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(st.script)); render(); }
    resetRover(); stopMsg();
  }
  var emitTimer = 0;
  function emit(){
    clearTimeout(emitTimer);
    emitTimer = setTimeout(function(){
      var s = getState();
      try { if (typeof window.__liveSyncEmit === 'function') window.__liveSyncEmit(s); } catch (e) {}
      try { if (window.parent && window.parent !== window)
        window.parent.postMessage({ type:'state', data:s }, '*'); } catch (e) {}
    }, 120);
  }
  window.getState = getState; window.setState = setState; window.__modelName = MODEL;
  window.addEventListener('message', function(e){
    var d = e && e.data;
    if (!d || typeof d !== 'object') return;
    if (d.type === 'setState') setState(d.data || d.state);
    else if (d.type === 'getState'){
      try { e.source && e.source.postMessage({ type:'state', data:getState() }, '*'); } catch (err) {}
    }
  });

  /* ============================================================
     Boot
     ============================================================ */
  var mainEl = document.getElementById('main');
  var cols = document.getElementById('cols');
  var markEl = document.getElementById('mark');
  /* The world is kept square by hand. Leaving it to CSS aspect-ratio let the
     drawn size and the element's size disagree, which stretched everything. */
  function resize(){
    var r = mainEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    var stacked = r.width / Math.max(1, r.height) < 1.15;
    mainEl.classList.toggle('stack', stacked);

    var availW = stacked ? r.width : r.width * 0.57;
    var availH = stacked ? r.height * 0.58 : r.height;
    var side = Math.max(140, Math.floor(Math.min(availW, availH)));
    world.style.width = side + 'px';
    world.style.height = side + 'px';

    layout(); draw();
    placeMark(stacked);
  }

  /* the mark sits across the join, half on the ground and half on the panel */
  function placeMark(stacked){
    var wr = world.getBoundingClientRect(), cr = cols.getBoundingClientRect();
    var mw = Math.max(190, Math.min(340, wr.width * 0.46));
    var mh = Math.round(mw * 0.18);
    var mx = (wr.left + wr.right) / 2, my = (wr.top + wr.bottom) / 2;
    markEl.style.width = Math.round(mw) + 'px';
    markEl.style.height = mh + 'px';
    markEl.style.left = Math.round(mx - mw/2) + 'px';
    markEl.style.top = Math.round(my - mh/2) + 'px';
  }
  if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(mainEl);
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  makeTray();
  render();
  resetRover();
  resize();

})();
</script>
